items.title: Tom Albert Interview, 1962-05-07
items.q: Well I was the first one taking him and Peter on the job. Oh yeah? Fest. They was learning and I'd take them down the breakway in the cane cart.

ctx.x: Yeah, I was playing violin. Yeah, playing violin.

Yeah, playing violin. Yeah. He didn't even tie it, but I never did. He used to come over there and play it when I was young, you understand? Mm-hm. Used to be around first. Well I was the first one taking him and Peeta on the job. He used to come over there and play when I was young, you understand? Used to be around the fest. Well I was the first one taking him and Peter on the job. Oh yeah? Fest. They was learning and I'd take them down the breakway in the cane cart. After grinding. I was the first one they…
Who else did you have in that band?

items.title: Tom Albert Interview, 1959-09-25
items.q: Peter, his father was playing guitar. Peter, yeah, his father was playing with Dorsey's band.

ctx.x: Oh, you had picnics now where you lived?

Under the oak trees, yeah. White picnics and colored picnics, they had on the oak trees, big oak trees. They used to have on the Sunday night, Sunday night, you know, they'd have big picnics there. Or they'd have big time there, the brass bands sometimes they played. You see, and I'll open the night, they'd have the brass bands. Now I'm in there, Dorsey, big father. He had a big, nice band in there. Peter, his father was playing guitar. Peter, yeah, his father was playing with Dorsey's band. And he used to have a…
Peter, was that the Dorsey that Fess told us about one time when they didn't give him anything to eat? They asked him something about cheese? Big Dorsey, yeah.
